linh: FYI nightly model-refresh cron failed for rw-1-prod on shard-12 at ~03:02 UTC, bench job then flaked. seeing download timeouts, tagging infra.

james: @linh can you paste the error snippet?

linh: ```
[2026-04-05T03:02:11Z] ERROR ModelRefresh: failed to pull checkpoint shard-12: HTTP 504 read timeout after 60s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/syncer.py", line 412, in fetch_checkpoint
    resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
  File "botocore/http.py", line 347, in send
    raise ReadTimeoutError
ReadTimeoutError
```

maria: I saw a similar 504 spike yesterday during the big sync. bucket + small object count could hit S3 request concurrency limits. which bucket is it?

linh: s3://redwood-model-sync/rw-1/2026-04-05 . manual rerun in progress: `/ops cron rerun model-refresh --shard=12` (started by me).

sre-bot: rerun requested by linh at 2026-04-05T03:15:02Z. status: queued.

zach: if rerun fails, can we bisect the nightly commits? @james you added the parallel-download optimization last week, could be related.

james: good call. I'll prep a git-bisect on the nightly range. can you grab the bench-id that flaked?

linh: bench-id: nightly-3456. CI job output link: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/nightly-3456

maria: I'll kick off 3 quick reruns of the bench after the model-sync rerun finishes and collect p99/p95. if >5% error rate we reduce parallelism.

sre-bot: rerun started at 2026-04-05T03:16:10Z. status: running on runner-gpu-07.

james: starting git bisect now across commits 9f3b1a..a2b4c0. I'll try to reproduce with a local sync harness first.

linh: rerun completed (sre-bot update coming). thanks all for quick responses.

sre-bot: rerun completed at 2026-04-05T03:29:12Z. status: success. artifacts: s3://redwood-ops/reruns/1712506789/shard-12/

linh: rerun success, requeued bench as nightly-3456-rerun. maria can you check results and close if clean?

maria: rerun results: 3/3 benches passed, latencies within baseline (p99 delta <2%). I applied a short-term guard: model-refresh concurrency 32 -> 16 for 24h.

james: bisect didn't reproduce locally (stops at commit 9f3b1a). no further action from me unless it reappears. :white_check_mark:

linh: leaving guard in place and monitoring. filing a follow-up ticket to add exponential backoff + jitter to syncer retries. thanks team. :thumbsup:
